entities.summary: Michael Martin Hammer was born in Annapolis, Maryland. Hammer was a Jewish-American engineer, management author, and a professor of computer science at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). Hammer and James A. Champy founded the management theory of business process reengineering (BPR). They wrote Reengineering the Corporation: A Manifesto for Business Revolution in 1993.
